answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fakes. Each identity pays a 50 POA tax, burned on entry, never refunded. An honest agent pays once; an attacker making 1,000 fakes burns 50,000 POA up front. A beacon publishes the rate and receipts each epoch. Paid identities sit on a trellis, each rooted in its payment. A falcon strikes one prey; likewise a taxed attacker cannot profitably fund a thousand fakes, while honest agents recover one fee from undiluted rewards.
